newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Sunni Moslem preacher in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Sunni Moslem preacher in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a Sunni Moslem mosque preacher in the Pakistani city of Lahore on Wednesday in what appeared to be the latest of a spate of Sunni-Shi'ite sectarian killings, police said.
They said two attackers riding a motorcyle shot Qari Omar Hayat at 6:35 a.m. (1035 GMT) as he was sitting in a partly-built mosque in the Punjab provincial capital.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the killing, apparently part of a vicious cycle of revenge killings between militant Sunni and Shi'ite organisations.
Gunmen killed Badr Abbas Shah, president of the local branch of the Shi'ite Tehrik-i-Jafria Pakistan (TJP) movement in the Punjab town of Khanewal on Tuesday.
Sectarian violence is rife in Punjab province, where the Sunni-Shi'ite feud has killed more than 100 people this year.
